name: High Society
summary: Auctions of luxury and prestige where players bid to be most fashionable without ending up the poorest.
rules_text: Each player has 11 money cards (values differing per set) kept hidden. Shuffle 16 status cards (10 luxury 1-10, 3 prestige 2x, 3 disgrace: Passe -5, Faux Pas discard one luxury, Scandale halves final) into a deck. Reveal top card each round. For luxury/prestige, clockwise auction: on your turn bid by adding money face-up to raise total over current high, or pass and take your money back and drop out. Last remaining bidder wins status card, discards spent money face-down, and starts next round. For disgrace, bidding to avoid it: first player to pass must take it, others discard spent money, passer starts next. Faux Pas forces discarding a luxury. Game ends immediately when the 4th dark-green card (3 prestige + Scandale) is revealed, without auctioning it. Then all reveal remaining money; poorest total is eliminated and cannot win. Remaining players score sum of luxury minus Passe, multiplied by 2 per prestige, halved if Scandale, highest wins, ties broken by money left then highest luxury.
